drg.description: Simple Pneumonia and Pleurisy without CC/MCC

timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Transthoracic echo: LVEF 59%, grade I diastolic dysfunction

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 79-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.51, bnp 225, creatinine 2.32, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 242, sodium 140, wbc 5.8; vitals dbp 65-70, heart_rate 76-81, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 15-16, sbp 132-136, spo2 96-97, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med); Transthoracic echo: LVEF 59%, grade I diastolic dysfunction
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.34, hemoglobin 13.3, platelets 241, sodium 140, wbc 5.8; vitals dbp 67-71, heart_rate 76-80, map 89-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 14-15, sbp 129-136, spo2 96-98, temp 36.9-37.1
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Furosemide 20 mg PO daily (home med)
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 79-year-old male, length of stay 4 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Type 2 diabetes. Hypertension. CHF. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
